title: FLIR1 object may be a balloon

tellings.quote: That of course suggests that what we're looking at is actually a balloon.

related.note: This explains the same FLIR1 object as a balloon, while the existing story calls it a distant aircraft. These are competing core claims about one object.

plain: The object in FLIR1, an infrared video that Navy pilots filmed off Southern California in 2004 of what others call the Tic Tac (a white oval object shaped like the mint), may simply be a balloon. The UFO skeptic Mick West, who analyses such videos, says this on the show after working through his own analysis of the footage: "That of course suggests that what we're looking at is actually a balloon." Others on the show read the same video as a real craft, so the point is whether the most famous Navy UFO video shows anything unusual at all.
